title: The Fine Structure Constant in the Bivector Standard Model
content: The geometrical view of the electron as a spinning bivector leads to the partitioning of the electron’s energy into internal and external. The reduced Compton wavelength, \( \bar{\lambda}_C \), is taken as the radius of the inertial ring (a 2D disc) while \( r_{e} \) characterizes the EM coupling scale. Within this picture, the Fine Structure Constant emerges as the structural ratio\( \alpha=\frac{r_{e}}{\bar{\lambda}_C} \). We make the partitioning explicit, derive simple ratios among moments of inertia and stored energies,and compare the Bivector Standard Model with the Standard model.
